title: Murazvo Wakaburitsa Nhaka
intro: Munhoroondo yekuramba, pane munhu akamira ane zita rake rakava yambiro kusvika kumagumo. Munhu uyu akasarudza ruvengo pane hukama hwepedyo, kusateerera pane kuzviisa pasi, uye akamira achipikisa chikumbiro chetsitsi. Teererai zvakanaka kumashoko ekare sezvatinozivisa kuti mweya uyu une mukurumbira wakaita sei.
clues: Ndakazvarirwa mumhuri imwe chete nemutumwa wekupedzisira waAllah, asi ndaimira ndichipikisana navo pese pandaienda.
Zita rangu raiva nerevo—zita rinoreva 'baba vemurazvo,' zita raizofanotaura ramangwana rangu risingaperi.
Ndakakuvadza mutakuri wechokwadi, uye kunyange mhuri yangu yakabatana mukurwisa uku kweutsinye.
Ndakashandisa pfuma yangu nesimba rangu kudzikamisa kudanwa kuna Allah, ndichitenda kuti mari inogona kudzima chiedza chaMwari.
Allah akanditsaurira chitsauko chose—chitsauko chipfupi zvekuti chinogona kuverengwa mumasekonzi mashoma, asi huremu hwacho hunoramba huripo kusvika paZuva reKutongwa.
Shamwari yangu muHupenyu Husingaperi inofamba iri shure kwangu, yakasungwa netambo yeshinda yakakomberedza mutsipa, yakatakura minzwa yayaiwanzoparadzira.
arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verse: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained. (111:2)
